config.script:
import csv
	import json
	from java.lang import String
	
	# Decode the file bytes into a string
	dataAsString = String(event.file.bytes, "utf-8")
	
	# Split into lines
	data = dataAsString.replace("\r\n", "\n").split("\n")
	self.custom.key = data
	
	# Extract headers
	headers = data[0]
	self.custom.keyHeader = headers.split(",")
	dHeaders = headers.split(",")
	
	# Extract data rows
	dataOut = []
	for i in data[1:]:
		if i.strip():  # Skip empty lines
			x = i.split(",")
			dataOut.append(x)
	
	self.custom.keyData = dataOut
	self.custom.keyHeaderLen = len([data[0]])
	self.custom.keyDataLen = len(data[1:])
	self.custom.keyDataset = system.dataset.toDataSet(dHeaders, dataOut)
	
	# --- JSON Conversion ---
	# Convert rows into list of dictionaries
	jsonData = [dict(zip(dHeaders, row)) for row in dataOut]
	
	# Store JSON string and object
	self.custom.keyJson = json.dumps(jsonData)
	self.custom.keyJsonObject = jsonData
	self.parent.parent.getChild("Table").props.data = jsonData

data = self.parent.parent.getChild("Table").props.data
	for each in data:
		self.view.getChild("root").apiAddDevice(
			str(self.view.custom.selected_IP), 
			str(self.view.custom.selected_port), 
			self.view.custom.API_KEY,
			each
		)

deviceData = self.parent.parent.getChild("Table").custom.template
	
	allKeys = set()
	allKeys.update(deviceData.keys())
	
	# Sort headers for consistency
	headers = sorted(allKeys)
	
	# Build data rows
	data = []
	row = [str(deviceData.get(key, '')) for key in headers]
	data.append(row)
	
	timestamp = system.date.format(system.date.now(), "yyyyMMdd_HHmmss")
	filename = "Device_Template_{}.csv".format(timestamp)
	
	exportDataset = system.dataset.toDataSet(headers, data)
	
	csv = system.dataset.toCSV(exportDataset, localized=False).replace('\"', '').replace('True','true').replace('False','false')
	system.perspective.download(filename, csv)
